purpose: The Batman/SpongeBob episode is now composed for 9:16 Shorts using the same supplied footage, dialogue and timing. Diagnostic proofs separately test two inputs through this layout.

examples.title: Gotham Meets Optimism
whyItWorks: The original 3:4 episode passed blind-agent execution. This 1080 × 1920 revision reuses its exact input, gameplay and six audio clips through the revised official layout.
12 contract tests and both 9:16 diagnostic proofs passed; the real 16.76-second revision decoded completely and its sampled frames were inspected.
knownWeaknesses: Gameplay and six voice clips were prepared before handoff; acquisition and voice generation are not in this release.
The Shorts layout is a maintainer refinement, not a new unaided authoring or blind-agent claim.
Detailed voice-performance, pacing and caption/speech review remains unrecorded.

examples.title: Same universe + crossover
whyItWorks: Two different scripts, casts, video sources and audio sequences use the same official renderer.
All assets for these free local checks ship in the ZIP.
knownWeaknesses: Diagnostic tones are not character speech; these checks do not establish creative fidelity.
